metadataRaw.title: How to Decompress Your Back IN SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to DECOMPRESS your lower back in seconds! 

This video will have multiple traction based (or pulling motions) stretching exercises that will help QUICKLY take pressure off the muscles and joints of the lumbar spine.

This is especially good for anyone suffering from lower back pain or sciatica caused from a disc bulge and herniation. 

All of the decompression exercises work a little bit differently, so go through them all and use what works to give you the most amount of lower back and sciatica pain relief.

As a bonus, all of these traction exercises can be done AT HOME, and may give quick relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and quickly decompress your lower back at home! 

Link to exercise ball: https://amzn.to/3K51ZP9

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:50 Back Hammer
3:54 Big Ball Decompress 
6:55 Cobra Lean
10:02 Soup Can Method
